Package com.robojacks.lib.auto

Class AutoSelector

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.command.SubsystemBase
com.robojacks.lib.auto.AutoSelector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subsystem
public class AutoSelector extends SubsystemBase
Picks the autonomous routine from a touch menu on the brain's screen: VEX's version of WPILib's SendableChooser<Command> on the dashboard. 

 private final AutoSelector m_autoSelector = new AutoSelector();

 public RobotContainer() {
     m_autoSelector.setDefaultOption("Do nothing", Commands.none());
     m_autoSelector.addOption("Left side", Autos.leftSide(m_robotDrive, m_intake));
     m_autoSelector.addOption("Right side", Autos.rightSide(m_robotDrive, m_intake));
     m_autoSelector.addControllerBindings(m_driverController); // D-pad left/right while disabled
 }

 public Command getAutonomousCommand() {
     return m_autoSelector.getSelected();
 }

The menu shows six buttons per page (arrows appear when there are more). Tap one to select it; the selection turns green and shows at the top. Selection is locked during autonomous so a bump of the screen can't change it mid-run. The menu only redraws when something changes, since drawing is slow on the brain.
